info.title: Mediflow API: planned endpoints
info.description: Endpoints the web app is built against that the API does not implement yet. Hand-written. When the API implements one, delete it here: the generated spec then provides it.

post.description: Opens a deep link to a record by its globally unique id. The server finds the hospital that owns the record, checks that the user is an active member of it, and rebinds the session to that hospital if another one (or none) is active. Every refusal is the same 403 link_unavailable, whether the record does not exist or belongs to a hospital the user does not work at, so a link cannot be used to find out what exists.

kind.description: The kind of record, e.g. notice.

200.description: The session, bound to the hospital that owns the record

get.description: Staff notices of the active tenant, newest first. Sample feature (F-13). Requires notice:read and the notices feature flag.

post.description: Archives a notice so it no longer appears in the list. Requires notice:manage.

get.description: Signed consents of one patient, newest first (MR-02, #190). Needs consent:read and the consents feature flag. The text and signature are in the single read.

post.description: Records a signed consent: the text as filled in from a version of a consent template, who signed, and the signature. Needs consent:sign. A signed consent is never changed or removed: there is no update or delete.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: One signed consent with its text and signature. Audited as a read of the patient record. Needs consent:read.
Certificates issued for one patient, newest first (MR-02, #190). Needs certificate:read and the consents feature flag.

post.description: Records a medical, fitness, birth or death certificate from the data entered. The server numbers it. Needs certificate:issue. An issued certificate is never changed or removed.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: Closed encounters whose record is not complete, with what is missing, the oldest first (MR-04, #192). Needs medicalRecord:read and the records feature flag. The server works out each gap from the encounter: an unsigned note, no diagnosis, no discharge summary for an inpatient stay, no signed consent for a procedure.
Diagnoses recorded as text that still have no code (state uncoded, the default), or coded ones, the oldest first (MR-04, #192). Needs medicalRecord:read and the records feature flag.

post.description: Gives a text diagnosis its ICD-10 code, at the version read. Needs medicalRecord:code. 409 version_conflict when the diagnosis changed, 422 when the code is not an ICD-10 code. Coding again replaces the code and is audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: The hospital's requests for copies of a record, the soonest due first (MR-04, #192). Needs recordRequest:read and the records feature flag.

post.description: Logs a request for a patient's record. Needs recordRequest:manage.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

post.description: Closes an open request as fulfilled or declined, with a note, at the version read; once only. Needs recordRequest:manage. 409 version_conflict or already_closed.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: Insurers, TPAs and corporates of the hospital, by name (IN-01, #181). Needs payer:read and the insurance feature flag. Archived ones only when asked for.

post.description: Adds an insurer, a TPA or a corporate. The code is the hospital's own and unique among its payers (409 duplicate_code). Needs payer:manage.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: One payer with its plans and rate agreements. Needs payer:read.

patch.description: Changes the fields sent, or archives and restores, from the version the edit started from (409 version_conflict). The code does not change. Needs payer:manage. Nothing past is changed by archiving.

post.description: Adds a plan to a payer: what it covers, the patient's share, its limits and eligibility rules. The code is unique among the payer's plans (409 duplicate_code). Needs payer:manage.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

patch.description: Changes a plan's terms from the version the edit started from, or archives it. Cover that applied to a past charge was kept with it. Needs payer:manage.

post.description: Adds a rate agreement for a period: a discount on the price list and rates for named services. Agreements of one payer never overlap (409 agreement_overlap), and a start in the past is refused (422 starts_in_past). Needs payer:manage.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

patch.description: Ends an agreement on a date, or opens its end again. Its rates are never edited: a change is a new agreement from a later date, so a bill priced under the old terms stays explainable. Needs payer:manage.

get.description: The insurance policies on a patient's record, newest first. Needs policy:read.

post.description: Records a policy on the patient's record against a payer's plan. Needs policy:manage.
Ends a policy: it can no longer back a new pre-authorization. Needs policy:manage.

get.description: The patient's pre-authorization requests, newest first. Needs preauth:read.

post.description: Raises a pre-authorization request to the payer of one of the patient's active policies. Needs preauth:manage.

get.description: The pre-authorizations of one visit with what the visit has been charged so far (billedMinor), to show the approved limit while billing. Needs preauth:read.

post.description: Records the payer's answer to a submitted request: approved (with the amount approved) or rejected. Needs preauth:manage.
Withdraws a submitted request. Needs preauth:manage.

get.description: The running bill of an inpatient stay (DS-03, #166): the charge ledger of the stay's encounter added up by source, with the bed days accrued so far (a line with `accruing: true` that is not yet a ledger charge), the deposits taken, what was paid on invoices of the stay and the estimate set at admission. `chargesMinor` is the sum of the lines (void charges left out); `balanceMinor` is charges less deposits and payments (negative: the patient is in credit). Needs charge:read, admission:read and the billing feature flag. Audited.

put.description: Sets or replaces the estimate of what the stay will cost, in minor units, with an optional note. The running bill then shows actual against estimate. Needs invoice:create and the billing feature flag. Audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

200.description: The running bill with the estimate

get.description: The deposits taken against a stay, newest first. Needs payment:read and the billing feature flag.

post.description: Takes a deposit against a stay (cash goes into the caller's open register session as a payment does). A deposit is never edited or removed; it is set against the final invoice. A discharged stay is 409 `stay_closed`. Needs payment:create and the billing feature flag. Audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: The final bill and settlement of an inpatient stay (DS-04, #167): the stay's invoices, what is still to invoice, credit notes, payments, the deposits held, applied and refunded, what is due or refundable, and whether the patient may be discharged under the hospital's policy. Needs charge:read, admission:read and the billing feature flag. Audited.

post.description: Sets the deposits held against an issued invoice of the stay as a payment: the lesser of what is held and what is due on it. Needs payment:create and the billing feature flag. 409 `no_deposit_held`, `invoice_not_payable`. Audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

post.description: Pays back the deposit held beyond what is due, in the mode chosen, with a reason. 409 `refund_exceeds` when the amount is more than the excess. Needs payment:refund and the billing feature flag. Audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: How the hospital gates discharge on the bill: `off`, `warn` (the person discharging confirms they have seen the bill) or `block` (nothing owed or unbilled). Needs invoice:read and the billing feature flag.

put.description: Sets the policy. Needs invoice:adjust and the billing feature flag. Audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

NoticePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

signedByName.description: The member of staff who recorded the signature.

body.description: The text as it was signed: the rich text document of the app, placeholders filled in.

signature.description: SVG path data of a drawn signature in a 300 by 150 box; absent for a typed one.

number.description: Assigned by the server, in order for each kind and year.

fields.description: What was entered, by the field names of the kind.

Payer.description: An insurer, a TPA (which administers claims for insurers) or a corporate with a credit arrangement. Contact details are the organisation's, never a patient's.

coverageMode.description: all_except: everything is covered but the listed services. only_listed: only the listed services are.

copayPercent.description: The patient's share of a covered charge, in percent.

sumInsuredMinor.description: The most the plan pays in a policy year, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

roomRentLimitMinor.description: The most it pays for a bed-day, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

coverageMode.description: all_except: everything is covered but the listed services. only_listed: only the listed services are.

copayPercent.description: The patient's share of a covered charge, in percent.

sumInsuredMinor.description: The most the plan pays in a policy year, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

roomRentLimitMinor.description: The most it pays for a bed-day, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

PayerPlanUpdate.description: The plan's terms as they should be (the code does not change), or only archived. The services listed replace the old list.

coverageMode.description: all_except: everything is covered but the listed services. only_listed: only the listed services are.

copayPercent.description: The patient's share of a covered charge, in percent.

sumInsuredMinor.description: The most the plan pays in a policy year, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

roomRentLimitMinor.description: The most it pays for a bed-day, in minor units. Absent: no limit.

RateAgreement.description: Prices a payer's patients are charged between two dates: a discount on the price list, and a rate for a service that replaces the list price.

effectiveTo.description: The last day it applies. Absent: until ended.

discountBp.description: Discount on the price list in basis points (100 = 1%).

status.description: Worked out by the server from the dates and whether it was ended.

preAuthRequired.description: Whether the plan asks for pre-authorization of an admission.

encounterId.description: The visit the cover is for, when known.

approvedMinor.description: The limit the payer approved. Absent until approved.

billedMinor.description: What the visit has been charged so far, worked out by the server from the charge ledger.

documents.description: What is enclosed with the request, by name. The files are on the patient record (documents).

count.description: Charges in the line; for bed days, the days.

accruing.description: True for bed days accrued to date that are not a ledger charge yet.

chargesMinor.description: Every charge of the stay in the ledger, void ones left out.

unbilledMinor.description: Charges not on an issued invoice yet.

invoicedMinor.description: The totals of the stay's issued and paid invoices, before credit notes.

paidMinor.description: Paid on the invoices, deposits applied included.

excessDepositMinor.description: Held beyond what is due, with nothing left to invoice: what may be refunded.
